confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Gothenburg and Swedish price levels for a July 2026 window; no live listings or price pages were checked. Restaurant anchors (beer, coffee, meals, wine) are moderately reliable. Cocktail and wine are less certain and were set relative to beer, since direct knowledge of local bar prices is weak. Hostel and hotel anchors are the least certain because July is peak season in Gothenburg and rates vary widely with events and booking lead time. The midrange meal anchor includes the Swedish VAT and any service charge on the bill, which can vary by venue.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis is Nordic price levels, with Gothenburg placed slightly below Stockholm and Oslo and close to Copenhagen for restaurants and mid-range hotels. Sweden's second-largest city, it is priced below the Nordic capitals for accommodation. Cocktail and wine were derived from the beer anchor using the usual local bar-to-pub ratio.
